techdesc_elbow: Faster elbow, 20% stronger and more knockout power.
techdesc_spinKick: Faster, stronger spinning kick with more knockout power.
techdesc_checkKick: Low block stops kicks and hurts the kicker's leg.
techdesc_ironChin: You take almost 20% more before going down.
ev_no_contract: No contract this time. Keep winning on the regional scene.
ev_rtu_advance: You cleared Road to UFC round {n}!
ev_invite_rtu: You've been invited to Road to UFC!
ev_invite_dwcs: You've been invited to Dana White's Contender Series!
dana_1: {name}, welcome to the UFC. You earned it.
dana_2: Everyone in {country} is going to be watching. Don't make me look bad.
dana_3: Sign here and let's get to work. I want to see you with the belt.
contract_body: {name} agrees to fight {n} exclusive bouts for {org}. Base purse: {purse} to show plus {purse} to win. Date: {date}.
news_released: {name} drops back to the national circuit.
news_ufc_contract: Dana White gives {name} a UFC contract.
news_rtu_win: {name} wins Road to UFC and signs with the UFC!
tut_move: Move with ◀ ▶ (hold). Step in and out of range.
tut_jab: Tap PUNCH once: JAB. Fast and light, measures distance.
tut_cross: Tap PUNCH twice in a row: jab + CROSS.
tut_hook: Tap PUNCH 3 times: jab + cross + HOOK. Get close.
tut_elbow: Tap PUNCH 4 times: the combo ends with an ELBOW.
tut_low: Tap KICK once: LOW KICK. Hurts the legs and slows him down.
tut_body: Tap KICK twice: low + BODY KICK (takes his breath away).
tut_high: Tap KICK 3 times: ends with a HIGH KICK, slow but can knock out.
tut_block_high: Now he attacks. Hold BLOCK HIGH to stop head strikes. Guarding costs no stamina.
tut_block_low: Now he kicks low. Hold BLOCK LOW to stop leg and body kicks.
tut_stamina: The yellow bar is your stamina. Each strike costs a bit; standing still or guarding recovers it fast. If it's empty, you hit weak.
tut_takedown: Tap TAKEDOWN when close. If it fails, try again (best when he attacks).
tut_sub: You're on top! Strike or tap SUBMISSION.
tut_tap: TAP the big button as fast as you can to finish the submission!
tut_done: Done! You know the basics. Tip: mix punches with low kicks and block when he starts a strike.
dec_to_cards: That's the fight! We go to the scorecards...
ev_short_notice: Short-notice call! The UFC needs a replacement and offers you the fight.
ev_retire_option: You're {age}. Most fighters retire between 38 and 42. Keep fighting?
career_summary: You retired at {age} after {fights} pro fights ({finishes} finishes). Belts: {belts}. Earnings: {money}.
spam_warn: You're throwing too much: you'll get countered
tut_spam: Don't throw nonstop: if you spam, your opponent reads you, slips and counters (and a big puncher can put you to sleep). Throw 2 or 3 strikes, cover up and go again.
tut_gnp: When you drop him, you jump on top automatically. Finish with PUNCH and ELBOW on the ground: if he can't defend, the referee stops it by TKO. If you get dropped, keep your guard high.
tut_jab_c: Tap JAB: fast and light, measures distance.
tut_cross_c: Tap CROSS: stronger than the jab, good reach.
tut_hook_c: Tap HOOK: hits hard, but you need to be close.
tut_elbow_c: Tap ELBOW: very short and powerful, up close.
tut_low_c: Tap LOW KICK: hurts the legs and slows him down.
tut_body_c: Tap BODY KICK: goes to the body and takes his breath away.
tut_high_c: Tap HIGH KICK: slow, but can knock out.
techdesc_bodySnatcher: Body kick hits 30% harder and drains much more stamina.
techdesc_legKiller: Low kick 35% stronger and faster: takes his legs away.
techdesc_heavyHands: Jab, cross and hook with 20% more knockout power.
techdesc_counterPuncher: When you slip or block high strikes, you sometimes fire back a hook or cross automatically (15% stronger).
techdesc_escapeArtist: Much easier to escape from the bottom and harder to submit.
techdesc_sprawl: Much harder for opponents to take you down.
techdesc_groundAndPound: Ground strikes 35% stronger; the referee stops it sooner.
techdesc_subHunter: Your submissions are much more likely to work.
techdesc_gasTank: +15 max stamina, 25% faster recovery and less fatigue between rounds.
techdesc_killerInstinct: When he's hurt (orange or red head) you hit 15% harder with more knockout power.
techdesc_unbreakable: Once per fight, a knockout becomes a knockdown and you keep fighting.
